title: Zesty Glassy Filipino Garlic Lumpia
description: A plant-based Filipino dish featuring garlic and a glassy jelly texture, served in a tajine clay vessel, this recipe is a unique twist on traditional lumpia.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the crumbled tofu and cook until lightly browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and agar agar.
Add the soy sauce mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the water and continue to simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Lay a spring roll wrapper on a flat surface and place a small amount of the garlic mixture in the center.
Fold the bottom half of the wrapper up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight lumpia.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Serve the lumpia in a tajine clay vessel and garnish with additional garlic if desired.
